gaps: P0: nothing. P3: only Bozière’s 1860 reconstructions (#7, #8) of the city ‘as it was in 1750’, which show neither 1750 as seen nor 1860, so skipped.
notes: Commons dates #3 by Jan Peeters’s birth year (1624); the plate is Caspar Merian’s, first issued 1654 (Rijksmuseum: 1654–ca. 1700), presumably in the Topographia Circuli Burgundici. The B&H plate is a perspective plan rather than a true view, kept because nothing else covers P1. #10 (1902) and #11 (1914) are similar rooftop views but fall in different periods.
